en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a wooded hill with a stone lookout tower and a large villa or hotel complex on the ridge. The building has the word "Schweizerhöhe" on its facade. In the foreground are open fields and what looks like a vineyard or cultivated rows. Decorative red script text is printed beneath the image, and small vertical text appears on the left margin, indicating the publisher and location.
